title: Upgraded NSW Digital Photo Card pilot – Terms and Conditions
summary: This page outlines the terms and conditions for participating in the upgraded NSW Digital Photo Card pilot, detailing how the credential can be used to verify identity at Service NSW.
who_can_apply: Hold a valid Digital Photo Card issued by Transport for NSW.
Be able to receive emails from Service NSW regarding the upgraded NSW Digital Photo Card and the Pilot.
Have a unique phone number and email address that is not shared or accessible by others.
Have Multi-factor Authentication enabled on your MyServiceNSW Account.
what_you_need: A valid Digital Photo Card issued by Transport for NSW.
A unique phone number and email address.
Multi-factor Authentication enabled on your MyServiceNSW Account.
A working and sufficiently charged phone to view and share the Digital Photo Card.
The latest version of the Service NSW mobile app.

faqs.q: How can I use my upgraded NSW Digital Photo Card?
faqs.a: You can use the upgraded NSW Digital Photo Card by digitally presenting it at a participating Service NSW Service Centre as part of a transaction that requires identity verification.

faqs.q: What are the rules for using the Digital Photo Card?
faqs.a: You must only use the sharing and verification feature at a participating Service NSW Service Centre during the Pilot. You must also keep your MyServiceNSW Account email and password secure and not share them with anyone.

faqs.q: What happens if I breach the terms and conditions?
faqs.a: If you breach these Terms and Conditions, or if your Photo Card is cancelled, seized, or if your other proof of identity documents expire, your participation may be affected.
